svg.title: OpenInstinct architecture diagram
svg.desc: A user texts an iMessage assistant through Sendblue. The inbound webhook is verified before a job is saved in Supabase PostgreSQL. A CrewAI worker uses OpenAI, saved notes and history, optional Gmail and GitHub tools through Composio MCP, and public-page research through Browserbase and Playwright. Replies return through Sendblue, with typing bubbles and read receipts. A Python scheduler queues due reminders using saved schedules in Supabase. Each sender has separate history, notes, and connections.

g.text: “In 5 minutes, brief me on the PRs I should review.”
Remote browser sessions for public pages.
